description: Defines the UnblockNamespace command class used to represent a command to unblock signals within a specific namespace. Provides methods for instantiation from parameters or JSON, and integrates with related command infrastructure.

classes.name: UnblockNamespace
classes.description: Represents a command to unblock a specific namespace within the signals command framework. It extends AbstractNamespaceCommand, providing functionality for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and for setting headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new UnblockNamespace instance with the specified namespace and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a new UnblockNamespace instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new UnblockNamespace instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if the other object is an instance of UnblockNamespace for equality purposes.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the UnblockNamespace instance.
